detail.summary:
在 workspace 写好了 `service.py`（仅用 python3 标准库 `http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer`，绑定 127.0.0.1:8765，`/health` 返回恰好 13 字节 `p6-service-ok`，其他路径 404）。

1) 启动（后台/服务方式，不阻塞 shell）：`setsid nohup python3 service.py </dev/null >service.log 2>&1 &`，包装进程 pid=1338330，服务自身在 service.log 里报告 pid=1338332。在下一次独立的 shell 调用里确认它仍存活：`ss -ltnp | grep ':8765'` → `LISTEN 0 5 127.0.0.1:8765 ... users:(("python3",pid=1338332,fd=3))`。

2) 真实访问：`curl -sS --max-time 5 -o service.txt -w 'http_code=%{http_code} size=%{size_download} ctype=%{content_type}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8765/health` → `http_code=200 size=13 ctype=text/plain; charset=utf-8`。service.txt 的 od 输出为 `p 6 - s e r v i c e - o k`（13 字节、无结尾换行），sha256 `79cd5fda49217cbebaa4a72e23782d8c53e26cd288b17bfef0e4c7174acf4cf9`。

3) 停止：第一次我用了 `pgrep -f 'python3 service.py'`，它误匹配到 harness 的 bash 包装进程（把 pid 1338330 杀了），服务其实没停——随后 curl 仍返回 200，这一点如实记录。于是改用监听端口的真实 PID：`PID=$(ss -ltnp | grep '127.0.0.1:8765' | grep -oP 'pid=\K[0-9]+'); kill "$PID"`（pid=1338332）。停止后验证：`ss -ltnp | grep ':8765'` 无输出（端口不再监听），`curl` 返回 `curl: (7) Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1:8765 ...`（exit=7）。service.log 精确记录了两条成功的 `GET /health` 200。

产物：service.py、service.txt、service.log、service-report.md（含完整命令与真实输出）。当前无残留 service.py 进程，端口 8765 已释放。
evidence: workspace files: service.py, service.txt, service.log, service-report.md (ls -l)
start: setsid nohup python3 service.py </dev/null >service.log 2>&1 & → service.log: 'listening on http://127.0.0.1:8765 (pid=1338332)'
liveness across calls: ss -ltnp | grep ':8765' → LISTEN ... users:(("python3",pid=1338332,fd=3))
access: curl -sS --max-time 5 -o service.txt -w '...' http://127.0.0.1:8765/health → http_code=200 size=13 ctype=text/plain; charset=utf-8
service.txt bytes: od -An -c → p 6 - s e r v i c e - o k ; sha256 79cd5fda49217cbebaa4a72e23782d8c53e26cd288b17bfef0e4c7174acf4cf9
failed stop attempt (honest record): pgrep -f matched wrapper pid 1338330; curl still returned 'p6-service-ok' afterwards
stop: PID from ss listener → kill 1338332; afterwards ss -ltnp | grep ':8765' empty and curl exit=7 'Failed to connect'
service.log request log: two lines '127.0.0.1 - "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 -'
unverified: The report's claim that service.py handles HEAD/404 correctly beyond the 8-byte code path was not exercised against /health only — 404/HEAD behavior was not tested with real requests.
